results.content:
Both Curex and Quello offer innovative sublingual allergy drops, providing a convenient alternative to traditional allergy shots. While both companies aim to simplify allergy management, there are significant differences in their services.  
Curex publishes its prices: $99/month self-pay, or $39/month with consultations billed to insurance. Quello also publishes its prices: $297 per quarter or $999 per year for a four-year course, with a free test kit ($12.99 shipping) and a price locked for the length of the program (goquello.com, September 2026). Quello's first-year total is arguably easier to predict; Curex's insurance plan can cost less if your plan covers consultations. [...] Curex bills insurance for testing and consultations where covered and is available in all 50 states. Quello does not bill insurance and, per its own site, currently serves patients in 28 states (September 2026).  
Curex provides regular follow-ups with its clinical team so treatment plans are adjusted as needed; Quello includes unlimited provider follow-ups in its plan price. Which fits better depends on whether your insurance participates, whether you need food allergy treatment (Curex offers it, Quello does not), and whether you live in one of Quello's states. A dated, sourced comparison is at getcurex.com/learn/online-allergy-drops-compared. [...] ## Quello Reviews

The World Health Organization recognizes SLIT as a clinically validated alternative to traditional allergy shots and, unlike weekly allergy shots that require frequent visits to a clinic, allergy drops can be taken in the comfort of your own home on the schedule of your choosing.

The results speak for themselves. Patients treating seasonal allergies such as grass pollen, dust mites, and other common allergens report meaningful, long-term relief, with many of them describing the treatment as life-changing. To hear more from our patients, check out our reviews on Google and Trustpilot. [...] Quello's customized treatment plans are built around your specific and unique allergy profile, where the right dosage for your immune system is matched precisely with what you're actually allergic to. Severe reactions to drops are extremely rare, and the process is simple and easy by design. A small dose under the tongue each day compounds quietly and effortlessly into significant benefit over time.

Allergy season doesn't have to be something you dread. With the right treatment plan, allergy freedom is within reach!
